10k.note: Renalytix is an in vitro diagnostics (IVD) company. Lead product KidneyIntelX.dkd is an FDA De Novo authorized prognostic blood-based bioprognostic test for early-stage diabetic kidney disease (DKD), included in 2024 KDIGO CKD guidelines. No therapeutic drug pipeline.

commercial_product.name: KidneyIntelX.dkd
commercial_product.indication: risk stratification for progressive kidney function decline in adults with type 2 diabetes and existing chronic kidney disease (stages 1-3b)
commercial_product.regulatory_status: FDA De Novo authorized (June 2023); CE-marked; included in KDIGO 2024 CKD Clinical Practice Guideline

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Diagnostics-only company. KidneyIntelX.dkd is a commercially marketed FDA-authorized in vitro diagnostic prognostic test, not a therapeutic asset. No active P1/P2/P3 drug or device interventional clinical pipeline.
